title: INHERENT LIMITATIONS OF AI FAIRNESS
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper is a theoretical survey and does not conduct any benchmarks. Religion is mentioned as an example of a protected trait for which fairness should be ensured.
findings: Religion is mentioned as an example of a protected trait, alongside gender and ethnicity. The paper argues that achieving fairness for such traits is inherently challenging due to the limitations of technical AI fairness approaches, such as the difficulty of mathematical formalization and the nuance required, which the dominant paradigms in AI fairness research often lack.
